create_doc_vqa_processor: create a DocVqaProcessor instance to process document VQA samples with custom question and answer feature keys
configure_question_answer_prefixes: configure the DocVqaProcessor with custom question and answer prefix and suffix strings for prompting
decode_vqa_annotation: decode a document VQA sample into formatted input text with question and answer tokens using _decode_anno
enable_multi_qa_expansion: enable multi-question-answer expansion mode by passing a multi_qa_feat to the DocVqaProcessor constructor
customize_render_dpi: customize the DocVqaProcessor render DPI and page squeezing options for document image processing
